description: Unit tests for the DNS configuration service in Chromium, testing configuration reading, invalidation, and host parsing behaviors.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceTest
classes.description: Test fixture for DNS config service unit tests, managing setup, teardown, and test utilities.

classes.name: MockHostsParserFactory
classes.description: Mock class for DNS hosts parser factory used in testing host parsing behaviors.

methods.name: OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when DNS configuration changes.

methods.name: WaitForConfig
methods.description: Waits until a DNS config notification is received.

methods.name: WaitForInvalidationTimeout
methods.description: Waits for the invalidation timeout to trigger, indicating config reset.

methods.name: ValidateNoNotification
methods.description: Ensures no configuration notification occurs within the timeout period.

methods.name: MakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a DNS configuration with a specified seed for testing.

methods.name: MakeHosts
methods.description: Creates DNS hosts entries based on a seed for testing.

methods.name: SetUpService
methods.description: Initializes the DNS config service and sets up config change watching.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment and initializes the DNS config service.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, ensuring no pending notifications.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Returns a factory for creating mock DNS hosts parsers.

methods.name: ParseHosts
methods.description: Mocked method to parse DNS hosts entries.

methods.name: CreateHostsEntry
methods.description: Creates a DNS hosts entry with a name, address family, and IP address.
